with fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r on r.rate_date = c.rate_date and r.currency = 'USD'
),
captures as (
    select a.order_id,
           a.amount_minor,
           a.currency,
           a.business_date,
           row_number() over (
               partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
               order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
           ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
    join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
    where a.status = 'captured'
      and not a.is_test
      and not o.is_test
      and s.country_code = 'SG'
      and a.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
),
order_values as (
    select c.order_id,
           sum(c.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting) as order_value_minor_usd
    from captures c
    join fx on fx.currency = c.currency and fx.rate_date = c.business_date
    where c.capture_rank = 1
    group by c.order_id
)
select null as key,
       cast(round(median(order_value_minor_usd)) as bigint) as value
from order_values
order by value
